headline: Montevallo unbeaten since Lee beat them in September
dek: Since that defeat Montevallo have won every match bar a draw at Delta State, and they closed the week with clean sheets against Delta State and UAH. Across all their matches they have scored 70 goals and conceded 17.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Scoring is concentrated at the top: Montevallo alone have more goals than UAH, Spring Hill, AUM, Christian Brothers and West Alabama together.

wire.line: Lee have conceded eight goals all season and lost only twice, to Trevecca and UAH.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Both matches still past their date with no result are Christian Brothers' matches from August.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Lainey Farabaugh has scored 14 goals from 94 shots for Montevallo.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Leslie Azouer has made 104 saves for AUM, at a save percentage of .846.

last_match.line: UAH came in off a win over Lee; Montevallo have not lost since September.

next_match.line: Eckerd have already held Delta State scoreless and beaten Valdosta State.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
